description.zh: add表示添加机器到机器组中， delete表示从机器组中删除机器。
description.en: The operation on the machine. Valid values: add and delete. A value of add specifies to add the machine to the machine group. A value of delete specifies to remove the machine from the machine group.

description.zh: 请求结构体。要添加或删除的机器列表。
description.en: The machines to be added or removed.
The name of the machine group.

descriptions.zh: 请求语法中Host由Project名称和日志服务Endpoint构成，您需要在Host中指定Project。
descriptions.en: Host consists of a project name and a Simple Log Service endpoint. You must specify a project in Host.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sls update-machine-group-machine --project ali-test-project --machine-group test-group --biz-body 192.168.xx.x --action add --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sls PUT /machinegroups/test-group/machines --project ali-test-project --region cn-hangzhou --action add --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body ["192.168.xx.x"]
